# Lúmi Web Agency

> Lúmi Web Agency (lumiwebagency.com) is a web development agency based in Odesa, Ukraine. We build turnkey websites and online stores (Shopify, WordPress, Weblium, Horoshop, OpenCart and custom code), and provide SEO, GEO (generative engine optimization), CRM integrations, payment integrations and branding. Clients in Ukraine, Czech Republic, Poland, Austria and Bulgaria. Site languages: Ukrainian and English.

## Services
- [Website development](https://lumiwebagency.com/services/website-development.html): landing pages from 500 EUR, multi-page sites from 700 EUR, from 7 days
- [Online stores](https://lumiwebagency.com/services/online-store.html): Shopify, Horoshop, OpenCart; WayForPay, Monobank, LiqPay, Stripe
- [SEO](https://lumiwebagency.com/services/seo.html): audits, semantics, technical SEO, ongoing promotion
- [GEO / AI search optimization](https://lumiwebagency.com/services/geo.html): getting into ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews answers
- [CRM integrations](https://lumiwebagency.com/services/crm.html)
- [Redesign](https://lumiwebagency.com/services/redesign.html)
- [Chatbots](https://lumiwebagency.com/services/chatbots.html)
